title: Cross-Desk Note with the Trade-Up Desk on Settling a Change Charge
content:
# Cross-Desk Note with the Trade-Up Desk on Settling a Change Charge

20 per cent of the figure reached for an agreed change, 8 per cent of it, or nothing of it is settled against an upgrade credit on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions. Which of the three follows turns on the credit the customer still holds and on the least they must spend for that credit to be usable.

## The shares

| Where | The studio settles |
|---|---|
| The customer holds an upgrade registration with credit still available and the credit still available stands at or above the least the customer must spend for that credit to be usable | 20 per cent of the figure reached against that credit |
| The customer holds an upgrade registration with credit still available and the credit still available stands below that least spend | 8 per cent of the figure reached against that credit |
| Otherwise | Nothing of the figure reached is settled against an upgrade credit |

## Where the records are

The credit still available and the least the customer must spend on the new piece for that credit to be spendable are held under Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes, on the customer's upgrade registration standing part spent. Where the customer holds no such registration, or the credit still available comes to nothing, nothing of the figure reached is settled against an upgrade credit.

## Readings (hypothetical)

On a figure reached of USD 1500.00:

- Credit still available USD 900.00 against a least spend of USD 750.00: the credit still available stands at or above the least spend, and USD 300.00 is settled against the credit.
- Credit still available USD 600.00 against a least spend of USD 750.00: it stands below, and USD 120.00 is settled against the credit.
- Credit still available USD 750.00 against a least spend of USD 750.00: the two are equal, the credit stands at or above the least spend, and USD 300.00 is settled against the credit.
